home.caption: Home is laid out along the lifecycle of a shoe. "Needs attention" only appears when something is actually waiting.

hotspots.label: Your name and role — check this is the right account before you start
Work that needs a decision today. Cards only show here when their count is above zero.
Sections follow the shoe: Receiving → In-Store → Put-away → Rescale → Sell & Ship → Browse

receiving-step1.caption: Step 1 of the receiving wizard. Supplier and tracking are both required — the server rejects a batch without them.

hotspots.label: Supplier — required. Pick from the list, or "Custom…" to add a new one (it is saved for next time).
Tracking number — required. Type it, scan the barcode, or photograph the label.
Boxes expected. Set above 1 and this becomes a per-box list, each with its own tracking number.

batches.caption: Every intake. Open batches are resumable; a box showing a red 0 has a tracking number but no items.

hotspots.label: Open batches are resumable — tap one to see its boxes, or to add a box that arrived late.
Boxes received / expected, and the item count. An "Empty" badge means nothing was scanned in.

inventory.caption: Rows merge by SKU and status. Scan a VIN to jump to a pair, or a shelf code to list that shelf.

hotspots.label: Search — a VIN, SKU or name. A shelf code (MNH-WH-A2-04) returns that shelf's contents instead.
Filters: date, supplier, status, and intake (receiving / rescale / in-store).
Sizes as quantity chips with a total. Tick the row to select every pair in it for a bulk action.

shelve.caption: Put-away. Scan the shelf first, then each VIN onto it — or pick from the list of shoes waiting for a shelf.

hotspots.label: Two modes: scan a shelf then the shoes, or pick from the pending list and assign a shelf.
Every scan flashes green (accepted) or amber (duplicate or refused) and buzzes the device.

nobox.caption: Pairs received without a box. Not sellable, and hidden from the listing grid until resolved.

hotspots.label: "Box found → With Box" makes the pair sellable again and sends it to Needs shelf.
Print box labels lives only on this page — it recreates a shoe-box label with a UPC barcode.

listings.caption: Listings & Sync, warehouse view: read-only, and Global indicator / Final price are hidden.

hotspots.label: II · AL · SX · SH — a badge reads "on" only when every pair in the group has that flag.
One row per SKU and status. Click it to expand the per-size table, where every field actually lives.

reconcile.caption: PO reconciliation. The chip says what is actually true — a clean order closes itself and never appears here.

hotspots.label: Active / Archived. The archive is loaded only when you open it, so the live queue stays fast.
The chip: Reconciled · Receiving · Received blind · N discrepancies · Boxes still out · Matched.

locations.caption: Locate Shoe. Search for a pair, or browse the tiles down Site → Area → Bay → Shelf.

hotspots.label: Search by name, SKU, VIN or UPC — or scan. Results group by SKU with a shelved / not-shelved count.
Each tile is a real URL, so Back drills up and a shelf can be linked to someone.

access.caption: Check Access. Approve accounts, change roles, issue a temporary password, or remove an account.

hotspots.label: Role picker — Warehouse or PH Team for staff, Supplier for an external partner.
Reset password shows a temporary password ONCE. Only its hash is stored.

ph-grid.caption: New Inventory. One row per SKU and status; expand it for the per-size table where every field lives.

hotspots.label: Date range — work the intake you are pricing. Days are Eastern, wherever you are sitting.
Refresh prices re-pulls the Global Indicator for everything on screen and recomputes Final.
Click a row to expand its per-size table; click Edit to change it. One row at a time per session.

po-create.caption: Opening a purchase order: the supplier, and one row per shipping label with its real tracking number.

hotspots.label: The supplier account that will scan this order out.
Drop a labels PDF here — one label per page — and each page's tracking number and courier are read off it.
One row per shipping label. Set the courier — that is what makes tracking pull from the right carrier.

po-overview.caption: Every order you opened, with live tracking per shipping label.

hotspots.label: Status chip, labels shipped, delivered count and units — then tap to expand per-label tracking.

supplier-list.caption: The supplier portal: every order we opened for you. Nothing else on the system is visible here.

hotspots.label: The order code. Quote this when you message us about a shipment.
How many of your labels are shipped, and how many units you declared. A replacement we sent is not counted here.

supplier-order.caption: One order: a card per shipping label, each with its own tracking number, status and contents.

hotspots.label: Refresh all tracking at once, or use the per-label button lower down to check just one.
Each shipping label is its own card, with its own tracking number and unit count.
Scan the shoes into this label. Re-scanning the same shoe bumps its quantity; each line's size and quantity stay editable while the label is open.
Close the label once it is packed. You can reopen it to edit, then mark it shipped when the courier has it.
The label's state: filling → packed → shipped → in transit → delivered.
